in_sanskrit.name: जिग्न्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'jignas', meaning 'to know' or 'to desire'. The suffix '-yaa' denotes a feminine form, thus 'Jignyaa' could mean 'She who desires' or 'She who seeks knowledge'. It is also possible that this name has a different origin and meaning, as it is not a commonly used Sanskrit name.

in_hindi.name: जिग्न्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name may also be used in Hindi, where it could be derived from the Hindi word 'jigana', meaning 'intense desire'. However, this is not a commonly used Hindi name and its origin is not definitively established.
